changelog:
v2.29.0 全面补全中文翻译

【考点中文翻译补全】
- 修复148条常考要点(examPoints)缺少中文翻译的问题
- 涵盖所有动词搭配、同义词比较、语法说明等考点
- 如：enable sb to do sth 使某人能够做某事、focus on = concentrate on 集中于

【派生词中文补全】
- 修复1条派生词缺少中文释义：missingly adv. 缺失地

【例句中文翻译补全】
- 替换17条占位例句(appears in recent gaokao exams)为真实带中文翻译的例句
- 为5条数字日期例句补充中文翻译（情人节、妇女节、儿童节等）

确保软件内所有英文内容都有对应中文翻译
devNotes: fix 148 examPoints entries in wordEnrichment.js missing Chinese translations; fix 1 derivatives entry (missingly adv.); replace 17 placeholder example sentences (appears in recent gaokao exams) with real sentences with Chinese translations; add Chinese translations to 5 number/date example sentences; ensure all English content in the app has corresponding Chinese translation
